Position Summary

Seeking a highly creative and product-driven Designer to lead the design and development of future collections across multiple categories, including fleece, loungewear, activewear, sleepwear, and accessories. This role will oversee the entire design process from concept through production, combining strong apparel design expertise with graphic and print design capabilities. - Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, including Illustrator and Photoshop.

- Excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills.

Hello Heart is on a mission to make heart attacks a thing of the past.

We're building the first voice interface a billion people use every day.

Our first product, Flow, lets you talk instead of type anywhere on your computer or phone, and turns messy speech into polished text that is ready to send. It's scaled from $2M → $50M in ARR in under 12 months with millions of users and thousands of enterprise customers. How we think →

The team is still small enough that every person shapes what gets built.

title: Product Designer | UI/UX | Mobile Products
description:
Are you a Product Designer who wants to be the first designer at a tech product company, not the tenth? Have you owned UX design across mobile and web in a SaaS product designed for non-technical users like SMB's? Are you a Product Designer or UI/UX Designer with a portfolio that shows your process, not just your pixels? This is a rare opportunity to own product design end-to-end at a well-established vertical SaaS company in the middle of a major platform modernization. If you're a Product Designer or UX Designer with SaaS and mobile design experience looking for a true ownership role, please read on.


This PE-backed vertical SaaS company builds all-in-one software for independent specialty retailers and has been the best-known name in its market for nearly 30 years. They are in the midst of a major overhaul and the platform is modernizing fast: mobile and integrated payments are coming soon, a full migration from legacy desktop to cloud SaaS is underway, and a company rebrand is in progress. This is the first design hire in company history; every product decision to date has been made by engineers. This incoming Product Designer owns the design foundation from day one and partners directly with a new Head of Product (hired in tandem) and front-end engineering.


What You Will Own

- Build the component library and style guide from scratch, the design system for every product built going forward
- Own UX for the mobile app and integrated payments launch
- Organize complex business data into clean, navigable interfaces for non-technical SMB users
- Partner with front-end engineers on spec-accurate builds and design documentation
- Serve as internal design partner on the company rebrand alongside marketing and an agency


What You'll Need
This role is a strong fit for mid-level Product Designers or UX Designers with SaaS experience who have designed for non-technical or SMB users.

- Portfolio to share (ideally demonstrating the full problem-solving process from discovery through delivery, not just visual output)
- Designed for non-technical users; usability and clarity are the standard, not visual polish
- Information architecture experience organizing complex data into clean, navigable interfaces
- Mobile and responsive web design across SaaS products
- AI-native design workflow
- East Coast time zone (ET preferred, CT workable)
Plus Skills

- 0-to-1 product design or major platform redesign experience
- POS, retail, or system-of-record product background
- Experience contributing to a brand identity or rebrand project


What You'll Get

- Competitive Comp Package: Base + Bonus (base is flexible based on experience)
- Strong benefits and a tight-knit team with a genuine culture
- Opportunity to truly own the function and influence the rebrand


If this opportunity aligns with your background, apply to learn more about the role and company.

title: Product Designer
description:
Description

Engrain builds map-based tech that’s redefining how real estate works. Our interactive, unit-level maps and powerful data integrations help over 1,000 companies—and 20,000 properties—to make smarter decisions, streamline leasing, and deliver better renter experiences. From prospect to renewal, our products give properties a spatial brain and a visual edge when it comes to property marketing and management. And it’s working: our churn rate is just 5%, and we’ve been putting up double-digit growth numbers every year.

We’re not your typical proptech company. We move fast, we stay curious, and we don’t do stale or corporate fluff. Backed by successful Seed and Series A rounds, we’re entering a phase of serious scale.

We are looking for a mid-to-senior Product Designer to join our growing Experience Design team. In this role, you will own the end-to-end design for our core products and critical customer experiences. You’ll be responsible for taking complex, multi-layered workflows and turning them into intuitive, elegant features that deliver immediate value to our users.

You will report directly to the Senior Director of Product Design and collaborate daily within a cross-functional team of product managers, engineers, and leadership.

What You’ll Do...



- Own the Core Experience: Lead the design strategy and execution for core product features, from initial ideation, wireframing, and prototyping to high-fidelity UI and developer handoff. 
- Balance Craft & Speed: Make design trade-offs confidently, knowing when to go deep on craft and when to ship a pragmatic solution that moves the product forward. 
- Leverage AI for Strategic Velocity: Integrate AI-augmented workflows to eliminate execution friction and accelerate prototyping—offloading operational overhead so the team can focus on high-level strategy, deep problem framing, and driving real customer outcomes over pure volume. 
- Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Partner closely with Product Management, Engineering, and Leadership to align user needs with business goals, ensuring technical feasibility and successful execution. 
- Advocate for the User: Utilize customer feedback, qualitative/quantitative data, and UX best practices to champion the user’s voice throughout the product lifecycle.

We're looking for a product designer who wants to operate like a founder.

Not someone who waits for tickets or perfect requirements. Someone who sees opportunities, prototypes fast, shapes product direction, and ships experiences that move the company forward.

Life insurance is one of the world's most important products. It's also one of the hardest to build, distribute, and modernize. Bestow exists to change that.

Bestow is a leading vertical technology platform serving some of the largest and most innovative life insurers. Our platform unifies the fragmented, legacy value chain, enabling carriers to launch products in weeks instead of years. Carriers choose us to scale and operate at unprecedented speed, powered by AI and automation.

Bestow isn't selling policies. We're building the infrastructure that helps an entire industry move faster, reach more people, and deliver on its promise.

The Bestow Product organization is responsible for defining, designing, and delivering exceptional digital experiences that solve real problems. You will join the Underwriting module — the team shaping how underwriters and managers work inside the Bestow workbench: case management, capacity and workload, analytics, and the AI-enabled experiences that make complex insurance decisions faster and more trustworthy. This is operational, B2B product design in a regulated domain — dense workflows, high stakes, and real users who depend on clarity under pressure.

You will report to the Senior Manager, UX Design. This role is open to Remote (US). 

About The Role

Bestow is seeking a Product Designer II to join our Underwriting module's mission of making insurance more accessible and human-centered. You'll own design for key workbench initiatives — turning complex underwriting and manager workflows into experiences that are clear, efficient, and defensible.

We're looking for a designer who combines strong research instincts with the ability to shape and ship ideas quickly. The most meaningful work on this team happens where ambiguity is high: discovery starts before requirements are fully baked, and the best designers here don't wait for a finished PRD — they help define the problem, test direction, and bring partners along with evidence.

Product Designer at Lumion
Location: In-office, South Jordan, Utah Comp: Salary, meaningful equity, and bonuses tied to company revenue


What Lumion does
Lumion is the all-in-one operating system for trade and technical schools. We power the entire institution: AI-driven lead generation and conversion, enrollment, financial aid, student lifecycle management, and tuition payments. Most schools are still stitching together five or six disconnected tools to do what our platform handles.


America has a massive skilled trades shortage and the schools that train electricians, welders, and nurses are the bottleneck. We're backed by TTV Capital and Tusk Venture Partners.
Why this role matters


You would be Lumion's first dedicated product designer. Until now, design has been done by the founders, product managers, and engineers. That carried us a long way, and it is no longer enough.


Our engineers build with AI-native workflows, so the constraint on the product is no longer how fast we can write code. It is how fast we can figure out exactly what to build and make it excellent. That is design work, and right now it is our bottleneck.


The people who use our platform are admissions directors, school owners, and finance staff who live in it all day, and students making one of the bigger financial decisions of their lives. Most software in this industry was built a decade ago and looks like it. You get to set the bar for what great looks like in this market.


The work
You will own design across the entire platform.


Product design end to end. You take features from PRD to shipped: user flows, interaction design, high-fidelity UI, and specs engineers can build from without guessing. You will work directly with the CEO and CTO in design sessions and own the outcome.


Prototypes. Before engineering commits to a build, we want a working prototype in front of real schools. You will produce clickable, testable prototypes fast and use what you learn to sharpen the spec before a line of production code gets written.


The design system. The platform spans lead management, enrollment, messaging, scheduling, payments, and reporting, and it grew fast. You will build the component library and interaction patterns that make it feel like one product, and that let engineers ship good UI without a designer in the room.


AI interfaces. Schools use Lumion to configure and supervise AI agents that text, email, and call prospective students. Designing how a non-technical admissions director sets up an agent, reviews its conversations, and learns to trust it is new territory with little prior art. You will define those patterns.


Student surfaces. Enrollment applications, document signing, and tuition payments, mostly on a phone. These flows handle real money and real decisions, and they have to be effortless.

About SyntheticFi


SyntheticFi is a fast-growing FinTech startup redefining the securities-backed lending world. We partner via B2B channels with Registered Investment Advisors (RIAs). Through our product, clients of RIAs are able to access the SPX box spread market, an institutional source of liquidity. 


We are leveling the lending playing field between individual investors and very large financial institutions. On the SPX box spread market, our users can borrow money to buy a house or a car at the same interest rate as financial institutions borrowing hundreds of millions of dollars.


Since launch in early 2025, we have consistently seen 20%+ month-over-month growth. We have earned the trust of hundreds of RIA firms to manage over $2 billions in regulatory AUM through the SPX box spread market.

At Roadrunner, we’re replacing the broken CPQ software that Sales teams have complained about, worked around, and given up on for years. Not improving it - replacing it. We’re building a new agentic stack called PQA - Prompt, Quote, Approve, designed for the enterprise, on a data model built for how pricing actually works today.

- 3+ in UX design, product design, or a similar role.

- Experience running user interviews and turning qualitative research into design decisions.
- Strong fluency with Figma or a similar tool for wireframing, prototyping, and design systems.
- Experience designing for workflows with real constraints, not only consumer apps.

Location: New York NY - Hybrid 3 Days a week in office

You have the drive to explore solutions independently, balanced with the humility to ask for help when you hit a roadblock. description:
About Agora Intelligence (d.b.a. Tilt)
Agora Intelligence is building the audited methodology layer agents call before touching portfolios. Our product, Tilt, is GitHub for rules-based investment methodologies: an open platform and marketplace where investment strategies are created, tested, audited, and distributed — by humans and AI agents alike. As AI agents begin managing real portfolios, they need a trusted source of verified investment logic before they can act. Tilt is that source.
We operate across two connected surfaces: InvestOS, an open standard that lets any brokerage or platform plug verified methodology into its own AI experience; and Tilt, the reference implementation of InvestOS. Tilt is an agentic harness where investors, portfolio managers, and creators can author, remix, and publish strategies. We're a small, senior team (from BlackRock, Bloomberg, BGI, and Quant Funds) backed by Portage Ventures, Lerer Hippeau, Cumberland Investments (and more), working with major brokerages and financial data providers.


What We're Building
InvestOS — an open standard for rules-based methodologies and its reference implementation.
We believe any idea — a theme, a trend, a thesis — can be turned into an investable view. On Tilt, anyone can express a view as a rules-based basket of assets in seconds, backed by evidence and scored against what actually happens. Whether you're modeling a thematic strategy, tracking an emerging technology, or capturing the public-market footprint of a private company, what used to take an index committee months now takes an API call — 100× faster, at a fraction of the cost. We also transform views found on the open web, into rules-based strategies. This lets us measure the performance of any opinion or prediction about the future. The unit is a tilt: a creator-authored view of the world.


The bigger bet: as AI agents take on more of investing, they'll need an open, trusted standard for how investment views are expressed, verified, and combined. When anyone can generate a strategy in seconds, the strategies aren't the asset. The system that versions, tests, and grades them is. We're building that standard — and the platform where those views are made. We’re also building the learning loops for when views resolve against reality, as measured by markets.

We're a team of ~25 senior-to-principal engineers, designers and AI/ML researchers. More than half the team are former founders. We move fast, challenge assumptions, and believe AI should fundamentally change how financial products are built. We have no management hierarchy and work remotely with 4 one-week hackathons per year. “Full stack” to us means you own a slice of the product, including its roadmap and go-to-market.

- Habitual use of AI tools in your own design process, whether for research synthesis, ideation, prototyping or production, and a clear view of where they help and where they fall short

- Today, we orchestrate tens of millions of Firecracker VMs each week, running CI for 5,000+ companies and hitting ~$50M in ARR in 2.5 years. We've more than 5x’d our revenue since the start of 2026. 
- We operate thousands of bare-metal machines across multiple regions, regularly schedule 100k+ vCPUs concurrently, and run a petabyte-scale Ceph cluster that we manage ourselves. 
- We’ve raised $58.5M from Seed to Series B, led by Google Ventures (GV) & Peak XV Partners, and we’re intentionally building a small, but exceptional team. 
- Blacksmith was founded by a team with deep systems and scaling experience, including building search/ads infrastructure at Faire, and operating large distributed systems at Cockroach Labs. Our GTM is led by Jon Boyer, formerly Head of Sales at Zapier. 
- We're now extending the same CI infrastructure into a broader platform: running agent sandboxes at scale and building our own background coding agent on top of it. 

Our Brand Designer

We’ve obsessed over brand since day one, and we’ve been laser focused on building a brand that developers love. You can see this on every surface that you interact with Blacksmith; our website, our product interfaces, our content.

We built that foundation with a brand advisor (and investor) who we continue to work with today. Your role will be to own this internally, our first in-house brand designer. You would be inheriting a real system, not a blank page, and taking ownership of where it goes next.

What You'll Do



- Own how Blacksmith looks and sounds across every surface: website, social, events, decks, swag and more. 
- Translate genuinely complex technical concepts into visuals that engage and build credibility with engineers. 
- Build a flexible visual system that holds up across multiple product lines and scales as we ship more, rather than a static brand guideline that goes stale in a quarter. 
- Work directly with the founders and with engineering on launch narratives, from the shape of the story down to the assets that carry it on Hacker News, X, and the blog. 
- Ship fast and iterate in public; treat the brand as something that evolves alongside the product. 
- Raise the bar on craft across the team, ensure we maintain quality whilst we move at speed. 

You’re a good fit if you have



- You're maniacal about polish and know what earns trust with a developer audience. Instinct and taste are critical here.

title: UI/UX Product Designer - AI Trainer
description:
About The Job

We are looking for an existing UI/UX Product Designer to help train AI models. You will measure the progress of these AI chatbots, evaluate their logic, and solve problems to improve the quality of each model.

In this role, you’ll use your design expertise to evaluate AI outputs, provide detailed feedback, and help refine the model’s sense of aesthetics, usability, and creative quality. Your insights will directly shape how the next generation of AI tools supports designers.

This is a new and growing area for our company — focused on teaching AI to better understand visual and design principles. At this stage, designers should apply through our general core assessment and then complete a qualification for Web & UI/UX Design. Once approved, you’ll not only have access to general AI training projects but also be invited to contribute to design-specific projects. These projects focus on areas such as UI/UX critique, product visuals, and aesthetic evaluation (including presentations and creative deliverables).

Advantages Of Contracting With Us



- You'll be able to choose which projects you want to work on and when
- You work on your own schedule, on your own computer, from the comfort of your own home
- General AI training projects start at $25-$30+ USD/hr, while design-focused projects start at $40+ USD/hr, with higher bonus rates available for certain projects

Responsibilities



- Review and critique AI-generated UI/UX designs, mockups, and visuals
- Evaluate the quality produced by AI models for correctness and performance
- Help train models to better understand aesthetic quality and user-centered design

Qualifications



- Fluency in English (native or bilingual level)
- Background in UI/UX design, web design, product design, or graphic design
- Strong understanding of visual hierarchy, interaction design, and user flow
- Excellent command of grammar, style, and brand voice
- A current, in progress, or completed Bachelor's is preferred but not required

Note: Payment is made via PayPal. We will never ask for any money from you. PayPal will handle any currency conversions from USD. Only applicants in the United States will be considered for this role. This is an independent contractor position.

Hummus Republic is a national Mediterranean fast-casual restaurant franchise. Our brand represents wholesome, flavorful Mediterranean cuisine served in a modern, inviting environment. As we continue to grow our brand, we seek a Brand Graphic designer to own and elevate our brand identity across all touch points.


Position Overview
The Brand Graphic Designer is a hybrid creative role responsible for communicating the visual brand identity of Hummus Republic. This position combines the skills of graphic designer and the strategic decision making of a Creative Director. The ideal candidate will communicate how our brand is perceived by customers and stakeholders while executing high-quality creative assets that support brand growth and consistency across all channels.


Key Responsibilities 

- Own and execute the visual aspect of the Hummus Republic brand across all print and digital.
- Design high-quality assets across digital and physical channels, including paid media, social, in-store signage, menus, packaging, print, OOH, and campaign materials.
- Act as a creative decision-maker, not just an executor, providing clear direction on layout, typography, color, photography, and overall visual tone.
- Own and safeguard Hummus Republic’s brand messaging by ensuring visual storytelling, copy alignment, and design decisions consistently reflect the brand’s voice, positioning, and values across all channels.
- Partner closely with marketing, operations, product, and leadership teams to align creative work with business objectives.
- Manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously while maintaining a high standard of design quality.
- Support franchisee ongoing design needs and maintain and evolve brand guidelines, templates, and systems to support 50+ locations.

- Ability to receive feedback, iterate quickly, and balance creative vision with practical constraints.

title: Product Designer, CMS

Figma is growing our team of passionate creatives and builders on a mission to make design accessible to all. Figma’s platform helps teams bring ideas to life—whether you're brainstorming, creating a prototype, translating designs into code, or iterating with AI. From idea to product, Figma empowers teams to streamline workflows, move faster, and work together in real time from anywhere in the world. If you're excited to shape the future of design and collaboration, join us!

We're looking for product designers who are excited to shape how teams build together. At Figma, design isn't just how something looks—it's how it works, how it feels, and how it scales. Our designers are systems thinkers, prototypers, storytellers, and craftspeople who care deeply about quality and collaboration. In this role, you'll turn ambiguity into clarity, push the product forward with engineers, PMs, and researchers, and help us invent new ways for people to design and build products together.

With an eye for simplicity and craft, curiosity for complex systems, and an appetite for technical challenges, you can help define the future of how software is made.

This is a unique opportunity for a designer who loves both craft and technical depth. You'll prototype, build, and ship alongside engineers while helping define foundational experiences that support millions of creators across Figma.

This is a full time role that can be held from one of our US hubs or remotely in the United States.

What you’ll do at Figma:

- Translate technically complex systems into intuitive, elegant user experiences

- Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, researchers, and designers throughout the product development process
- Help raise the quality bar across the organization through thoughtful feedback, design critiques, and mentorship

- 4+ years of experience designing UX and UI for a software product of similar scale and complexity
- Exceptional product design craft with strong visual and interaction skills, especially in complex software where systems thinking matters as much as any individual screen — with a proven ability to simplify technically complex systems into intuitive, thoughtful user experiences

We're a team of makers and dreamers, turning strategic ideas into flawless retail executions. We collaborate closely with our clients to elevate the expected and embrace the new, the next, and the complex.

Nothing is impossible— If you can shop it, we can do it.

Overview

At Saatchi X, Visual Designers create simple, bold, unmistakably on‑brand work across integrated omnichannel campaigns. We believe strong ideas deserve strong craft—and that great design happens when curious, opinionated people collaborate across disciplines to make work that actually connects.

Designers here are makers first—strong visual thinkers who execute beautifully and bring energy, curiosity, and care to every assignment.

- Support Technical Designer in the management of the fit approval process.
- Assist Technical Designer in development of accurate specs and construction details and issuing to the factory.

- Develop a good working relationship with design and production departments.
- Active participation in the fit approval process.

title: Product Designer, Design Systems
description:
About Us

Our mission is to reinvent the way people learn, starting with language.

Learning a language can change a life by opening doors to new cultures, careers, and communities. Two billion people around the world are actively trying to learn a language, but the best way to learn (one-on-one tutoring) is hard to access at scale and hasn’t been meaningfully improved in decades. Speak is building a human-level, AI-powered tutor in your pocket: a conversation-first experience that lets learners actually speak, get instant feedback, and progress through carefully designed lessons. The result is a complete path from beginner to confident speaker across multiple languages.

Speak first launched in South Korea in 2019, where Speak has now become the number one language learning app, and we now serve learners across many markets and 15+ languages. Speak is one of the world’s leading AI companies, with over $150m raised in venture investment from OpenAI, Accel, Founders Fund, Khosla Ventures, and more, with a distributed team across San Francisco, Seoul, Tokyo, Taipei, and Ljubljana.

About The Design Team

We’re a small, high-craft team that sits at the intersection of research, invention, and product thinking. We build consumer and B2B experiences used by millions across 150+ markets — and a lot of the work is genuinely novel: inventing how someone talks to an AI tutor, what feedback feels like when you’re learning out loud, and how progress should be measured and celebrated.

We stay close to learners through prototyping, interviews, betas, and experiments. We take craft seriously, iterate fast, and value a high-trust critique-and-build culture. We have something to prove — and we care about doing work that is both useful and genuinely excellent.

About This Role

We’re hiring a seasoned Designer to improve how design and engineering work together, starting with a world-class, agent-first design system.

By agent-first, we mean the system is structured so humans and AI agents can make the same good decisions: choosing the right components, applying the right patterns, using consistent names, and reviewing UI against shared rules.

This is a systems thinker, high-craft, high-collaboration role. You’ll work closely with dedicated engineers who will be your collaborators in bringing this to life across our product surfaces. You’ll own the design quality, semantics, and product usefulness of the system; engineering will own the technical architecture and implementation, with close collaboration on component APIs, constraints, and adoption.

Scope



- You’ll work across iOS, Android, and web.
- We’re mobile-first in the near term, with an expectation that components and patterns translate cleanly to web as those surfaces expand.
- This role focuses on product surfaces (not the marketing site).

What you’ll own



- Design ↔ Engineering workflow improvements. Treat the seams between functions as a design problem: shared language, fewer re-made decisions

About TMO,

The Mortgage Office is the most trusted loan management platform in private lending. Founded in 1978, we power the full loan lifecycle for over 1,100 lenders, including private money firms, CDFIs, nonprofits, and government agencies, servicing more than $190 billion in loans.

We're recognized as G2's #1 Loan Servicing Software and Capterra's Best Ease of Use. With offices in Huntington Beach and San Mateo, we're now building the next generation of AI-native lending tools, and hiring a Product Designer to help lead that work.

The Opportunity

This is a research-forward role. Our design team already has strength in systems thinking, front-end craft, and shipping polished UI fast. What we need alongside it is someone who obsesses over why servicers do what they do, where their real workflows diverge from the software, and what the data says about it, then translates that into problem definitions the team can build against, and designs or prototypes to pressure-test the ideas.

Because we're building AI-native features into workflows where trust is non-negotiable, we need someone who thinks hard about what that means before opening Figma, and whose judgment sharpens with every round of discovery. You should apply if you get energized by understanding real user behavior, can navigate business and technical constraints, and can still bring a design to life once the problem is framed.

What You'll Own

Research & Discovery



- Conduct user interviews, usability sessions, and contextual observation to understand how servicers actually work, asking behavioral questions and controlling for bias, not just collecting opinions.
- Evaluate features and user flows through product analytics (Pendo, PostHog, etc.), using task-flow analysis, error rates, and click velocity to find what to fix and validate that shipped work improved outcomes.
- Run competitive analysis and gather community feedback to inform what we build next.

Problem Framing & Strategy



- Translate research findings into clear problem definitions and opportunity areas.
- Partner with engineers, stakeholders, and customers to shape product vision and roadmaps, not just execute on them.

Design & Prototyping



- Design polished, trustworthy interfaces that feel premium.
- Rapidly prototype ideas in code (using AI) or other methods to pressure-test concepts and build alignment fast.
- Ensure designs and prototypes are complete and well-documented, accounting for edge cases, error states, and responsiveness.

Required

What You Bring



- 3+ years (or equivalent experience) as a Professional Designer and/or User Researcher
- Demonstrated depth in user research: interviews, usability sessions, synthesizing qualitative data, and turning behavioral insight into design direction
- Portfolio showing end-to-end product work: problem framing, research, and iteration, not just polished mocks

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
📫 About Stable

Our mission is to make it simple to headquarter any business on the internet. Today, we provide companies with a business address and a dashboard to manage their physical mail online. Over 15,000+ companies like Brex, Doordash, and Gusto use Stable to automate their mailroom and act as their permanent business address with the IRS, state, and vendors.

The rules that regulate US entities were written in the 1800s. Stable abstracts these antiquated requirements with tools that empower modern companies to move forward faster.

These rules don't make sense for the way we work today — work takes place in the cloud and businesses are no longer tied to physical proximity or geography.

We’re on a mission to fix the broken system of entity management. Starting with business addresses and mail, we’re abstracting the complex, archaic systems that make company-building painful and turning them into delightful experiences — so that modern businesses have the tools they need to move forward faster.

We're backed by leading Silicon Valley investors like Y Combinator, Craft Ventures, Shakti, Hustle Fund, and founders from companies like Lattice, Apartment List, and FlexJobs.

Our business is at an inflection point. We’re growing quickly with a product people love and we’ve proven we can service companies of all stages and industries — from early-stage startups to publicly traded companies in industries like technology, logistics, and property management.

This is an opportunity to join an early-stage startup as one of the first employees and do work that directly impacts the future of how companies are built.

👩‍💻👨‍💻 Role

As a designer at Stable, you'll work in an AI-forward, builder-led environment. You'll write product briefs, query live business data, and work increasingly close to the code. You'll own your work from discovery through delivery, and you'll make impactful product decisions (prioritization, tradeoffs, and scope) in close collaboration with engineering and stakeholders.

A defining aspect of this role is the nature of the problems you’ll work on. Stable sits at the intersection of digital software and physical operations. Designing great customer experiences means understanding real-world workflows inside processing centers handling 1M+ pieces of mail, and translating that complexity into simple, intuitive software. This cross-disciplinary work is challenging, nuanced, and a core differentiator for Stable.

Our design team is small but established. You’ll build on strong foundations, collaborate with experienced designers, and play an active role in shaping how design shows up across the product as the company scales.

title: Principal Product Designer
description:
IFS is a billion-dollar revenue company with 7000+ employees on all continents. We deliver award-winning enterprise software solutions through the use of embedded digital innovation and a single cloud-based platform to help businesses be their best when it really matters–at the Moment of Service™.


At IFS, we're flexible, we're innovative, and we're focused not only on how we can engage with our customers, but on how we can make a real change and have a worldwide impact. We help solve some of society's greatest challenges, fostering a better future through our agility, collaboration, and trust.


We celebrate diversity and accept that there are so many different perspectives in this world. As a truly international company serving people from around the globe, we realize that our success is tantamount to the respect we have for those different points of view.


By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a global, diverse environment; you will be joining a winning team with a commitment to sustainability; and a company where we get things done so that you can make a positive impact on the world.


We're looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can #MakeYourMoment so that we can help others make theirs.


If you want to change the status quo, we'll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS.



Job Description


You'll be designing for people whose work actually matters: maintenance engineers, field service technicians, operations planners working in environments where the software either helps or gets in the way. The stakes are real and the problems are hard, which is exactly what makes this role interesting.


At IFS, product design means owning the full problem, not just the screens. You'll work in a cross-functional squad alongside engineers and product managers, with the scope and support to do the work properly. From problem framing through to something shipped and measured.


But the deeper question is harder than that. The industries IFS serves (field service, asset management, manufacturing, supply chain) are changing faster than the software that runs them. By 2030, we're not confident the interface paradigms we rely on today will still be the right ones. AI, ambient computing, voice, autonomous systems: any of these could fundamentally change how an operations planner or a field engineer interacts with software, or whether they interact with it at all.


That's not a problem we've solved. It's the problem you'd be working on.


 


What you'll do 


Product Design 



- 
Own design for defined feature areas end-to-end — from problem framing through to production-ready Figma files, with a clear rationale for every decision 



- 
Work in a cross-functional squad with engineers and PMs, making real decisions rather than executing on someone else's brief 



- 
Present design thinking to stakeholders with confidence — handling pushback with evidence, not just convicti

Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.

We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

Faire is a company invested in the importance of design—as a Staff Product Designer you’ll join a close-knit, collaborative team that cares deeply about creating beautiful, intuitive experiences. Our team plays a central role in identifying and solving meaningful problems for our customers, designing for thousands of independent retailers and maker brands growing their businesses in our marketplace.

In this role, you’ll help shape Faire’s product alongside partners in research, engineering, product, data, and analytics. As a Staff Product Designer, you'll drive strategy, craft, and end-to-end experiences while supporting key business goals across both your pod and broader pillar work.

We’re looking for designers who excel across the full product development lifecycle, care about the details, and have a strong track record of shipping high-quality experiences. You bring a growth mindset and a genuine curiosity about our customers.

We're looking for candidates open to working in San Francisco, CA or New York, NY.

- Lead end-to-end design from deep discovery and rapid prototyping through polished execution and production. 
- Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, product, and data teams to explore new paradigms 
- Tell powerful stories that connect design vision to tangible business and customer impact, inspiring alignment across teams and leadership.
- Push Faire’s design system forward through the lens of your work—evolving patterns, motion, and visual language that scale across the platform.
- Prototype fearlessly using modern tools to explore new ideas, test assumptions, and accelerate innovation.
- Mentor and elevate other designers—sharing your craft, process, and storytelling approach to raise the bar across the org.

Qualifications



- 10+ years of experience designing complex, high-impact digital products.
- Deep expertise in interaction design, visual craft, and systems thinking.

description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?

We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

This role leads the creative development of Consumer Products Group (CPG) packaging and product design across the US and Canada, ensuring brand consistency, market relevance, and high-quality standards. It serves as a key liaison between internal creative teams, franchise partners, and external licensees, guiding innovation and strategic alignment across all CPG packaging platforms. - Review and approve marketing materials (e.g., web banners, social media, in-store displays) in Creative+ prior to launch. 
- Collaborate with outside studios to ensure adherence to brand standards, acting as a creative liaison between studios and licensees. 
- Routinely meet with the CPG business team to align on project timelines, priorities, and deliverables. 
- Develop presentation and guide materials to support internal and external creative initiatives.

- Approximately 5-10 years’ experience in design, with solid creative abilities and aesthetic judgment. 

Additional Qualifications



- Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign).

- Deep knowledge in typography, layout, packaging design, and color theory.

title: New Product Design Coordinator
description:
We make unique and useful items designed in collaboration with artists all over the world. It all starts with our 10-person New Product Development (NPD) team, made up of designers, art directors, writers, and project managers. The team dreams up product ideas, directs and refines work by the artists who make those products, and collaborates with partner factories all over the world to manufacture about 120 new items each year that are sold in thousands of shops in the U.S. and overseas.


As NPD Coordinator, you’ll manage projects for all of these processes. You’ll help the NPD Manager to coordinate artist contracts; you’ll help develop product specifications, templates and schedules; and you’ll assist in selecting and communicating with dozens of international suppliers. There will be zigs and zags to every project, and you’ll work with the team to creatively solve both big and small challenges.


This is a full-time, in-house position in Pittsfield, Mass., smack in the middle of the beautiful, bucolic Berkshires – just a few hours drive from NYC and Boston. It’s a fun, fast-paced, open work environment with health insurance, profit-sharing, a retirement plan, awesome coworkers, and room to grow. This position will require some international travel.


YOU ARE:
Curious and super-organized. Entrepreneurial, flexible and kind. You’re an amazing communicator and problem-solver, and you love working with a team to learn new things. You like art and people and just a little bit of chaos to keep things interesting.


YOUR SKILLS ARE:
3+ years of experience working in creative and collaborative environments.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Mastery of MS Office and Google Workspace, especially Excel and PowerPoint.
Familiarity with the Adobe Creative Suite.

title: Nail Product Designer & Collection Development Manager
description:
Brand: PaintLab

About PaintLab
PaintLab is an award-winning press-on nail brand making salon-inspired nail art accessible, expressive and easy to wear. Our products are available through major retailers, including Walmart and CVS, as well as PaintLab.com. We move quickly, follow culture closely and develop trend-forward collections across colors, finishes, shapes and nail-art techniques.

About the Role
PaintLab is seeking a highly creative, detail-oriented Nail Product Designer & Collection Development Manager to lead the development of new press-on nail collections from initial concept through final production approval.
This is not solely a graphic design position. The ideal candidate understands nail art, beauty trends and physical product development and can translate creative ideas into commercially viable designs that factories can execute accurately.
You will develop seasonal concepts, create nail artwork and production files, review physical samples and communicate detailed revisions to our overseas manufacturing partners. A major part of this position involves consistently evaluating nail samples in person and managing multiple rounds of revisions until every detail—including color, shape, finish, placement and embellishment—is correct.

- Develop seasonal press-on nail collections, capsules and retailer-specific assortments
- Research emerging nail, beauty, fashion and cultural trends
- Create collection concepts, mood boards, color stories and design presentations

- Communicate directly with overseas factories and suppliers
- Troubleshoot execution issues and identify realistic production solutions
- Partner with product development, packaging, sales and marketing teams
- Adapt concepts for different retailers, customers, price points and merchandising needs
- Maintain an organized development calendar and design library
- Ensure approved production samples accurately reflect the original creative direction

Qualifications

- 3+ years of experience in nail, beauty, cosmetics, accessories or consumer-product design
- Strong portfolio demonstrating nail art, surface design, beauty products or trend-driven collections
- Advanced proficiency in Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop
- Experience creating technical artwork, specifications or factory-ready design files
- Strong understanding of color, propor

title: Senior UX Product Designer
description:
About Rokt

Rokt is an ecommerce technology company with the mission of making every transaction more relevant. The Rokt Ecommerce Network leverages proprietary machine learning recommendation systems, powering billions of transactions for hundreds of millions of customers, and is trusted to do this by companies like Live Nation, Fanatics, Macy's, AMC Theatres, PayPal, Uber, Hulu, Staples, Albertsons and HelloFresh.

We are looking for a Senior UX Product Designer

Compensation

Target total compensation ranges from $214k-$255k, comprised of a fixed annual salary of $174k - $215k, plus employee equity plan grant. In addition, you will receive world-class employee benefits.

Equity grants are issued in good faith and are subject to company policies, board approval, and individual eligibility.

The Role

We're looking for a Product Designer to join our team. You'll design end-to-end experiences across traditional UI and AI-powered (agentic) workflows, shaping how users interact with data, automation, and personalization.

This role requires strong systems thinking, a high bar for craft, and the ability to work across teams and problem spaces. You'll define and evolve interaction patterns across both traditional and AI-driven experiences, creating scalable, intuitive, and intelligent products.

You're comfortable with ambiguity, move quickly, and take ownership—unblocking yourself and others to drive impact. Your work will directly improve how customers activate and personalize data, driving adoption, efficiency, and revenue.

This role is for a designer who sees AI as both a design tool and a design challenge: someone who can use AI to work faster and smarter, and who can craft experiences that make AI feel intuitive, trustworthy, and human.

Responsibilities



- Leverage the latest techniques of AI design and testing to rapidly build prototypes and scale UAT.
- Design and deliver end-to-end experiences across traditional UI and AI-powered workflows, defining and evolving interaction patterns (e.g., automation, human-in-the-loop, recommendation systems, smart assistants)
- Build and maintain scalable systems, patterns, and components, ensuring consistency and quality across products
- Define and evolve UX standards for AI features across Rokt's product suite, ensuring consistency, accessibility, and ethical design principles.
- Translate complex ML model outputs and data-driven insights into intuitive, user-centered product experiences that are explainable and trustworthy.
- Work across teams with a system-level mindset, while mentoring others and raising the overall bar for craft and quality
- Embed AI tools (e.g., generative design, LLM-assisted synthesis, AI prototyping) throughout your design process to increase velocity and creative range.
- Experiment with and evaluate emerging AI design tools, advocating internally for those that meaningfully improve the team's output quality or speed.

Requirements



- 5+ years of UX or product design exp

Gemini is a global crypto and Web3 platform founded by Cameron and Tyler Winklevoss in 2014, offering a wide range of simple, reliable, and secure crypto products and services to individuals and institutions in over 70 countries. Our mission is to unlock the next era of financial, creative, and personal freedom by providing trusted access to the decentralized future. We envision a world where crypto reshapes the global financial system, internet, and money to create greater choice, independence, and opportunity for all — bridging traditional finance with the emerging cryptoeconomy in a way that is more open, fair, and secure. As a publicly traded company, Gemini is poised to accelerate this vision with greater scale, reach, and impact.

You have a bias toward making over talking. You'll contribute to Gemini's visual identity across social, web, and campaigns alongside a fast moving brand and growth team to make work that earns attention.
This role sits at the intersection of brand, social, and design. You'll work on the Brand team and be one of three creatives on a lean and fast moving team.

- Collaborate with social and marketing teams to move quickly from idea to execution

- Proficient in Figma, Photoshop, Illustrator, or similar tools
- Already using AI in your creative workflow

- Highly organized and able to take a project from concept through to delivery

title: Mobile Designer
description:
Set the standard for exceptional mobile design at Gallup and shape how mobile thinking informs product decisions.

As a mobile designer at Gallup, you’ll own the design of Gallup’s mobile experience across our portfolio of iOS and Android apps and the broader mobile surface. You’ll ship excellent mobile work while influencing how product managers scope work and how cross-functional partners think about mobile from the start.

You’ll partner closely with mobile engineering and the broader product design team to ensure our mobile experiences feel native, intentional and world-class.

What You’ll Do



- Own mobile design across Gallup’s mobile apps on iOS and Android
- Drive a mobile-first mindset across the product organization, ensuring mobile is considered up front by product managers, designers, researchers and engineers
- Champion mobile-first user research by partnering with researchers to study mobile-specific behaviors and translate those insights into product decisions
- Collaborate with mobile engineering on feasibility, platform conventions and interaction patterns
- Contribute mobile-specific patterns to the design system and push for parity between mobile and web
- Partner with web product designers to align concepts, flows and UX decisions across platforms

title: Founding Product Designer
description:
About Ceno

Ceno is building the neobank for the US-to-Asia corridor: one account where Americans invest in global equities, hold and move USD, KRW, and JPY, and run a financial life that spans two continents.

We're starting with the hardest and most valuable piece: a retail brokerage that gives US investors direct access to Korean and Japanese equities. USD in, USD out, with FX, custody, KYC, and tax reporting handled invisibly by an AI-native, agentic back end. Recent regulatory changes in Korea opened direct market access to overseas brokers for the first time, and we intend to turn that opening into the default way America invests in Asia.

The product promise is true localization: buying any global equity feels exactly like trading the US markets, with the research, filings, and news that local investors trade on translated and delivered in real time by our AI research engine. From there the map expands, market by market, until global equities sit on one shelf, with stablecoin-enabled settlement moving money across the Pacific in minutes instead of days. The AAPI community is our beachhead; US retail is the market.

We're seed-stage, on a multi-phase path to our own FINRA-licensed broker-dealer, and building the founding team now. There is no design team yet. You are it.

Why this role exists

A brokerage is its interface. In a category no one has seen before, buying a Korean or Japanese stock, the design is the product: it is what makes an unfamiliar, intimidating action feel as ordinary as buying Apple. Robinhood proved that design can create a category; Coinbase proved that design is what earns trust when people move real money into something they don't fully understand. Ceno needs both, and it needs them from the first screen.

This is a founding-team seat with full ownership of product design end to end: the mobile app, the onboarding and funding flows, the trading and research surfaces, the design system, and the brand as it shows up in the product. You are the first designer, so you both set the vision and push the pixels. You'll partner directly with the CEO on what we build, with the CTO and engineers on how it ships, and with the growth team on how it converts. Three things define the first 12 months.



- Onboarding to a funded account. Design the flow that turns a curious download into a KYC-verified, funded, trading account. This is the number the company lives on, and it runs straight through your screens: sign-up, identity, funding, first trade.
- Making the foreign feel native. Design a trading and research experience where a Korean or Japanese equity, its price, its filings, its news, its currency, feels as legible and safe as a US stock. This is the core product bet, and it is fundamentally a design problem.
- The system and the bar. Establish Ceno's design language and component system from zero, and set a quality bar high enough that a regulated financial product feels trustworthy and a consumer product feels delightful,

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
About Nuvo

Nuvo is building the infrastructure that powers trade in the physical goods economy.

Every part of modern life depends on physical goods: the food we eat, the fabric we wear, the steel and concrete that shape our cities. Behind it all are 50 million businesses trading $100 trillion each year.

Consider how housing gets built. One company cuts down trees, another turns the wood into building materials, another sells the product wholesale, and a contractor uses them to build homes. Each step is a business trading with another to turn raw materials into finished goods.

Most of these businesses still operate through offline networks, held together by fragmented systems, manual processes, and institutional memory. When trade is slow, costly, or error-prone, the effects cascade — resources get misallocated, businesses can’t grow, and consumers face higher costs and fewer choices.

Nuvo builds technology that makes trade fast, automated, and intelligent. More than 75,000 businesses already use our platform, and we’re backed by $45M from Sequoia, Spark, Founders Fund, and Index as we build the operating system for global commerce.

The Role

Design at Nuvo sits at the center of how our platform works and feels. Our products span identity, risk, payments, AI, and more, all built on top of the connectivity between businesses on our platform. As a Senior Product Designer, you’ll shape how this system comes to life for thousands of businesses, defining how complex operations become simple, intuitive, and powerful.

You’ll operate with deep ownership, collaborating closely with engineering, product, and customer teams. You’ll help define the next generation of experiences that make Nuvo increasingly compelling across new industries and use cases.

- Drive design for major product areas that serve thousands of businesses

title: Founding Product Designer
description:
About Ceno

Ceno is building the neobank for the US-to-Asia corridor: one account where Americans invest in global equities, hold and move USD, KRW, and JPY, and run a financial life that spans two continents.

We're starting with the hardest and most valuable piece: a retail brokerage that gives US investors direct access to Korean and Japanese equities. USD in, USD out, with FX, custody, KYC, and tax reporting handled invisibly by an AI-native, agentic back end. Recent regulatory changes in Korea opened direct market access to overseas brokers for the first time, and we intend to turn that opening into the default way America invests in Asia.

The product promise is true localization: buying any global equity feels exactly like trading the US markets, with the research, filings, and news that local investors trade on translated and delivered in real time by our AI research engine. From there the map expands, market by market, until global equities sit on one shelf, with stablecoin-enabled settlement moving money across the Pacific in minutes instead of days. The AAPI community is our beachhead; US retail is the market.

We're seed-stage, on a multi-phase path to our own FINRA-licensed broker-dealer, and building the founding team now. There is no design team yet. You are it.

Why this role exists

A brokerage is its interface. In a category no one has seen before, buying a Korean or Japanese stock, the design is the product: it is what makes an unfamiliar, intimidating action feel as ordinary as buying Apple. Robinhood proved that design can create a category; Coinbase proved that design is what earns trust when people move real money into something they don't fully understand. Ceno needs both, and it needs them from the first screen.

This is a founding-team seat with full ownership of product design end to end: the mobile app, the onboarding and funding flows, the trading and research surfaces, the design system, and the brand as it shows up in the product. You are the first designer, so you both set the vision and push the pixels. You'll partner directly with the CEO on what we build, with the CTO and engineers on how it ships, and with the growth team on how it converts. Three things define the first 12 months.



- Onboarding to a funded account. Design the flow that turns a curious download into a KYC-verified, funded, trading account. This is the number the company lives on, and it runs straight through your screens: sign-up, identity, funding, first trade.
- Making the foreign feel native. Design a trading and research experience where a Korean or Japanese equity, its price, its filings, its news, its currency, feels as legible and safe as a US stock. This is the core product bet, and it is fundamentally a design problem.
- The system and the bar. Establish Ceno's design language and component system from zero, and set a quality bar high enough that a regulated financial product feels trustworthy and a consumer product feels delightful,

📫 About Stable

Our mission is to make it simple to headquarter any business on the internet. Today, we provide companies with a business address and a dashboard to manage their physical mail online. Over 15,000+ companies like Brex, Doordash, and Gusto use Stable to automate their mailroom and act as their permanent business address with the IRS, state, and vendors.

The rules that regulate US entities were written in the 1800s. Stable abstracts these antiquated requirements with tools that empower modern companies to move forward faster.

These rules don't make sense for the way we work today — work takes place in the cloud and businesses are no longer tied to physical proximity or geography.

We’re on a mission to fix the broken system of entity management. title: Brand Designer
description:
About Us

Conversion is the agentic marketing automation platform for modern enterprises such as Plaid, ClickHouse, Webflow, and Productboard. Our platform lets growth teams run their entire go-to-market motion in one place, from acquisition through retention, with AI agents doing the work that legacy tools like Marketo, HubSpot, and Pardot can't.

We've raised $28M+ from Abstract Ventures, True Ventures, and HOF Capital. The team is based in San Francisco and includes engineers, designers, and operators from Airbnb, Palantir, Pinterest, IMC, Shopify, LinkedIn, and Microsoft.

About The Role

Hey 👋 Kyle here. I run product and growth at Conversion, and up until now I've also been the person holding our brand. Every logo lockup, every deck, every launch page, every color and type call. I've loved doing it. It's also the thing I most need to hand off, and the hardest for me to let go of.

So, now I'm hiring a brand designer. Someone who owns our visual identity top to bottom and builds the system the rest of the company designs against.

That means you're the person who decides what Conversion looks like and feels like everywhere it shows up. The identity system (logo, type, color, grid, motion language), the guidelines that keep it consistent, and the craft bar that everything gets held to. You'll bring it to life across web, social, launch creative, decks, and collateral. When we ship a new feature or run a launch, you're making the page look incredible, cutting the launch video, and setting the visual story. This is brand and identity work, not product UI (Levi owns our in-app surfaces), and not code. If you think of yourself as a design engineer, this probably isn't your seat.

I care about this a lot, which is why the bar is high. Portfolio first, always. I want to see identity work you've built from the ground up and can walk me through: what the problem was, what you made, why every decision. I'd rather see one brand you shaped end to end than ten logos you touched. Tool fluency is table stakes (Figma, Illustrator, After Effects / Lottie / Figma Motion, Claude Design), and I'm looking for roughly 1 to 5 years of doing exactly this.

The people who crush this role tend to be the same off the clock. Side projects, an art Instagram, a vlog, a brand they built just because. Strong opinions about advertising and what good creative actually is (I keep a Super Bowl ad tier list, so no judgment). The friend whose dinner party has a custom menu. Obsessive about craft down to the pixel. If that's you, and you want to own a brand rather than execute someone else's, this is a rare one.

This role is in-person 5 days/week in San Francisco.

What You'll Own



- The visual identity itself: logo, type, color, grid, motion language, and the guidelines that keep all of it consistent as more people build on top of it
- The look and feel of Conversion everywhere it shows up: web, social, decks, collateral, launch creative
- Launch work end to end: the launch

title: Product Manager, Data Platform & Integrations
description:
About Auxilius
Auxilius builds clinical trial financial management software that helps drug companies take control over trial costs, manage financial risk, and optimize R&D spend. We provide data, context, and frameworks that empower teams to bring drugs to market faster and more cost-effectively.
With 100+ customers relying on our platform today, we're at an exciting inflection point where thoughtful product decisions have real impact, and the ability to quickly translate customer needs into intuitive scalable solutions can unlock massive market opportunity.


The Role
We're looking for a Product Manager to own the data moat end to end: how external data gets into Auxilius, how we model and connect it once it's in, and how users query it and act on it.
Auxilius wins on data. The more sources we connect and the better we model what lands, the more we can do for sponsors that no one else can. You'll work across three pillars: Integrations, Data Platform, and Activation + AI, and you'll be expected to move fluidly between driving our integration roadmap, partnering on our data warehouse, and shaping how AI features surface value back to users.


Why This Matters
The life sciences industry spends $250-300 billion annually on clinical R&D, yet outcomes remain stubbornly poor. Even when the science works—when the data shows promise—trials rarely finish on time or on budget. The cost of drug development has risen relentlessly for decades (Eroom's Law), and the industry has accepted this as inevitable.
We don't.
At Auxilius, we believe science matters, but trial outcomes depend on more than science alone. We believe sponsors deserve tools built to handle the complexity of clinical trials, and that while science is inherently unpredictable, budgets don't need to be. We're building software that proves biotechs can bring drugs to market quickly and cost-effectively—it just takes the right tools.
This is your chance to own the data foundation the rest of the company builds on, at a stage where what you build will define the company—and help reshape an entire industry's approach to R&D efficiency.

Integrations

- Own how external data flows into Auxilius
- Drive our integration roadmap, including consolidating and optimizing ERP, EDC, CTMS, TMF, and FP&A system integrations, expanding depth so sponsors feel natively connected

- Communicate timelines and manage work stream directly with Sponsor’s IT and technical teams as part of initial integration build during customer implementation

- Partner with engineering to optimize a canonical, well-modeled data layer that everything else sits on top of

About Sycle

Sycle is a market-leading global SaaS company with the mission of facilitating the delivery of better hearing to the world. Founded in 2001, we have grown to be the leading practice management solution for audiology (hearing care) providers, with more than 65% market share. The Sycle practice management solution frees up valuable time so our customers can grow their businesses through delivering high quality patient care and exceptional services that delight their customers. Small hearing care practices and some of the largest retailers utilize our software in 13 countries worldwide.

The Sycle team is 120 strong. We are headquartered in Lone Tree, Colorado with a large remote workforce across the US and Canada. We are seeking an experienced Product Manager – Patient Intake to reinvent how patients check in, register, and onboard into audiology practices. description:

Health systems, hospitals, and payers use Notable to improve healthcare quality, close gaps in patient care, drive member enrollment, and patient acquisition, retention, and reimbursement, scaling growth without hiring more staff.

We are on a mission to improve the lives of patients, staff, and clinicians - to improve healthcare for humanity. This isn't just a lofty goal - it's something we're achieving every single day. When you join Notable, you become part of a force actively transforming healthcare. Our aim to impact 100 million patients isn't just a number; it's a commitment to creating meaningful change on a massive scale.

Therefore, our culture is purposeful in pursuit of this mission. We believe our culture gives each person the opportunity to do the best work of their lives, work with the best teammates, and have fun achieving great things together.

About the Product Design Team

High agency, high transparency, richly informed.

We're a small design team that reports to the Head of Product Design, who reports to the Chief Product Officer. Each designer is embedded in a cross-functional pod, working closely with Product and Engineering partners. We work at varied fidelities, adopting with intention new tools and processes that help us learn, apply judgment, communicate, and ship.

Role Summary

The job is making AI-powered healthcare workflows buildable, operable, and trustworthy in an industry where getting it right matters. It requires someone motivated by complex systems that have real consequences and impact on human lives.

We're looking for a Senior Product Designer to own product design across multiple workstreams within a cross-functional pod. You'll work on a multi-persona platform, designing for:



- Internal and external users who build healthcare workflows,
- the operators who run them,
- and the patients and staff who experience them.

What You'll Do

Break down problems and articulate your reasoning as you drive from rough concepts to shipped products.

title: Senior Designer
description:
Inbox Monster is hunting for a sharp, stylish Senior Designer to join our small but mighty Marketing team. We recently gave our brand an epic refresh, and now we're looking for someone who's excited to help shape what comes next. This isn't a role where you'll be handed a brand guide and told to color inside the lines. You'll help evolve the visual identity of one of the fastest-growing companies in the email marketing space, creating work that's memorable, clever and unmistakably Inbox Monster.
We're looking for someone based in Atlanta for a hybrid role, with 1–2 days a week in our Buckhead office for collaboration, creative brainstorming and the occasional excuse to eat tacos together.

What You'll Do


- Create bold, beautiful, on-brand creative across our website, landing pages, email campaigns, social media, presentations, print and whatever comes next.
- Be a steward of the Inbox Monster brand, helping us maintain consistency while pushing our creative forward.
- Partner closely with our Head of Marketing and Content Lead to dream up campaigns that stand out in crowded inboxes (and crowded LinkedIn feeds).
- Bring ideas to the table, not just pixels. We love designers who think strategically and bring big ideas to the whiteboard. 
- Jump into a fast-moving environment with curiosity, flexibility and a collaborative mindset. No precious egos—just people making great work together.

What We're Looking For


- Expert-level experience in Figma. It's currently the center of our design universe.
- Working knowledge of Webflow to create and update landing pages, product pages and other web experiences.
- Strong skills in Adobe Illustrator for illustration and print-ready design.
- Curiosity about emerging AI-powered creative workflows. You'll be excited to experiment with tools like Claude and to help build and maintain our exciting Claude-based design system. Not because it's trendy, but because it makes great work even better.
- A passion for great visual storytelling, thoughtful typography (we’re very protective of our custom Monstie Sans font) and clean, modern design.
- Incredible attention to detail and pride in your work. Good enough doesn’t exist in this role. 

Bonus Points If You Have


- Experience designing for a SaaS or technology company.
- Experience in email marketing (or an unhealthy fascination with it).
- Motion, illustration or light front-end skills that help bring your ideas to life.

About Inbox Monster

Inbox Monster helps email teams send with confidence. Inbox Monster’s deliverability and testing tools turn insights into action with complete visibility into email performance. Get proactive support that cares about your brand’s reputation as much as you do. Companies that trust Inbox Monster can save up to 53% of their time on QA and achieve a 30% improvement in inbox placement in 30 days. Find your email rawwwr at inboxmonster.com.

title: Senior Product Designer
description:
About Us

Dorsia is at the forefront of hospitality-tech innovation, redefining how the world gains access to the most in-demand restaurants, events, and experiences. By fusing cutting-edge technology with the art of luxury hospitality, we empower our members to secure impossible-to-get reservations while providing operators with unprecedented levels of control, visibility, and revenue optimization.

In 2025, we grew revenue 480% and scaled to 400+ venues across 25 destinations, with the launch of our Culture Calendar extending Dorsia beyond restaurants into the world's most sought-after cultural moments.

Backed by $54M in funding from investors including Index Ventures, Invus, and Red Sea Ventures, and strategic partners including MoonPay, Major Food Group, and The Dinex Group - Daniel Boulud, we are entering our most consequential phase of growth and reshaping the global hospitality landscape. We're adding exceptional talent to drive what comes next, and that's where you come in.

About The Role

Dorsia is seeking a Senior Product Designer to drive the execution of our digital product experience across our digital presence. This is a hands-on individual contributor role for an AI-native designer who takes major features from first concept to ship, prototyping in working software rather than static mockups. The strategy is set. We need someone who can turn it into a working product at a level of polish worthy of our members. The pace is fast and the volume is high, with several major features in flight at once, and AI tooling is how we sustain that pace without sacrificing craft.

What You’ll Do

Design Execution & Craft



- Design major features end to end, moving from first concept through launch alongside product managers and engineers.
- Work at a high level of fidelity from the start, delivering approval-ready designs rather than rough passes.
- Perfect the micro interactions, transitions, and haptic details that make a product feel considered and premium.
- Produce a high volume of high-quality work within the design framework set by our Senior Designer.
- Rapidly iterate on new features, using AI tools to absorb feedback and turn it around without losing momentum.

Product & Systems

-  Own end-to-end UX/UI design for supply chain software products — from initial concept and user flows through to high-fidelity Figma deliverables ready for handoff or user testing.

-  Apply UX research and design methodologies — including usability testing, user interviews, iterative prototyping, and information architecture — throughout the product lifecycle.

title: Digital Experience Design Director
description:
About the Role


Jack Porter is seeking a Digital Experience Design Director to create interactive digital experiences that live inside memorable physical environments. Our work brings together strategy, storytelling, environmental design, media and technology for sports venues, museums, visitor centers, branded environments and other public spaces.


This is not a traditional website or SaaS product-design role. You will design experiences for touchscreens, kiosks, media walls, interactive galleries, large-format displays and other technology-enabled installations. You will be a hands-on designer responsible for carrying work from early concept through UX, UI, prototyping, development and installation.


You will serve as the digital design lead for assigned projects, partnering with the VP of Design, Design Directors and multidisciplinary project teams to establish, direct and execute the digital experience from concept through implementation. While Design Directors own the physical environment, you will own the creative vision, quality and execution of the digital experience, ensuring both disciplines come together as one cohesive story. 


Unlike many director-level positions, this is a player-coach role. The Digital Experience Design Director is expected to remain deeply involved in the design work while also providing the creative leadership necessary to guide the digital discipline across the project lifecycle. 


Leadership Expectations


As the Digital Experience Design Director, you will lead the digital discipline on assigned projects while remaining an active, hands-on designer. You will independently own the digital creative direction from concept through implementation, requiring minimal day-to-day creative oversight while collaborating closely with executive creative leadership to ensure every digital experience aligns with the project's overall vision.


You will establish the digital creative vision, guide concept development, direct digital experience strategy and provide creative leadership throughout the project lifecycle. While you will continue designing interfaces, interactions and prototypes, you will also be responsible for elevating the work of others, making project-level digital creative decisions and ensuring every digital touchpoint contributes to a cohesive guest experience.


What You’ll Do


Lead the Digital Creative Direction



- Establish the creative vision for the digital experience in partnership with the VP of Design and project Design Directors.
- Translate project goals into a cohesive digital strategy spanning interaction, interface, content, motion and technology.
- Lead digital concept development from early ideation through final implementation.
- Serve as the primary creative decision-maker for the digital experience throughout the project lifecycle.
- Ensure every digital touchpoint supports the project's overall creative vision and storytelling objectives.
